note: Adolf Piltz completed his Ph.D. dissertation in 1881 on the distribution of natural numbers as products of factors, and Wikipedia indicates he formulated a generalized Riemann hypothesis in 1884. The Piltz divisor problem is a natural generalization of the Dirichlet divisor problem that grew from his work, but the exact year the problem was first posed could not be verified from available sources.
